build_adsorbate_slab_configs: build adsorbate-slab configurations by placing an adsorbate on sampled binding sites of a catalyst slab
get_binding_sites_random: get random binding sites on a slab surface using Delaunay triangulation of surface atoms
get_binding_sites_heuristic: get energetically favorable binding sites using Pymatgen AdsorbateSiteFinder for ontop bridge or hollow sites
place_adsorbate_on_site: place an adsorbate molecule at a specific binding site with random rotation and no atomic overlap
check_atomic_overlap: check if there is atomic overlap between adsorbate atoms and slab surface atoms using covalent radii
